items.title: Sidney "Jim Little" Brown Interview, 1960-05-27
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...when Will was up there making records... [INTERVIEWEE] think it said, that was the first bass ever was on records.

ctx.x: Oh, I forgot the year now. My, that was in 26. Wasn't that the year? Something along in about that time. Around 26, 25 or 26. When did you make the records, do you remember? Yeah. Yeah. Oh, no.
It was after that though, wasn't it? But I know, I can remember, they said, when, uh, when Will was up there making records, I
think it said, that was the first bass ever was on records. I had to hear, when I made the records with Sam Morgan. Yeah.
